title: We had Laura as our tour...
text: We had Laura as our tour guide. Really nice tour, informative and a good pace. I relaxed at the cafe with an aperol spritz overlooking the garden afterwards. I would recommend
author: Zara_N

title: Tour of Alcazar de Sevilla
text: Very good tour of a beautiful site. Sign up and meet up were easy and convenient. Tour was interesting. The guide was knowledgeable and approachable. The only issue was that it was difficult to understand him through the audio system.
author: BuzzBeagle2017

title: Beyond expectations.  Girl was amazing
text: Guide Girl was clear and sweet all the times… She knew a lot about the Royal Alcazar…  always reminded to walk with care and was attentive if we got lost , ONE WORD.  Excellent
author: maria_r

title: Learn all about Guadi and his work
text: Worth the extra money to have a small group tour. The amount of information shared was over the top.  Cool to understand the significance behind how things were designed and built
author: Justin_F

title: Highly recommend
text:
We took the English tour. Jose was our guide. He did an awesome job of explaining each and every aspect of Alcazar very beautifully. He made it lively. Thank you for a wonderful experience. 

Highly recommend them.
author: hemangifernandes

title: This tour is a must
text: This is a historical place and having a guide is a must, plus you skip the long lines, which will save you a lot of time!
author: 651lidar

title: Worth the time
text: There was no guide. This was a wonderful walk around an amazing place. Great architecture and history. Beautiful views of the town.
author: John_G

title: Highly recommended
text:
Our guide, Vicky, with her mixture of knowledge and sympathy made the visit to the Alcázar a great experience allowing us to know a part of the history of the Alcázar in a very enjoyable way.
Very efficient both the management of inputs, and the audio audio system used.
author: Merche_0771

title: I dreaded guided tour but it was worth it!
text: I tend to hate ‘tours’ as it always feels like I cannot explore the place for myself. As our guide said ‘it’s not a tour, it’s an experience’. Right amount of cheesy to provide humour and lighthearted feel. The tour was informative, pace didn’t feel like something was dragging to say necessary info or fast enough and feeling like you cannot take pictures. You can hear tidbits and information beyond what you’ll read in a guide book - in an imaginative way. I’d be happy to go on another tour and see if other guides will be as good (I don’t remember the name of our leader but he was fab).
author: YnaSky88

title: Interesting Tour
text:
I took part in the guided tour of the Alcazara. 
I don't remember the name of the guide (a girl), very good, prepared and patient in keeping the group inside the crowded place. 
After the explanations, we could stay inside for as long as we wanted. 
On the day I booked, this was the cheapest option for this visit (with tickets and priority access included). 
I recommend the visit of the Alcazara and the gardens!!
author: Eli_A_2009
